prompt: HTML img sizes attribute source-size-value valid CSS functions
answer: For an HTML `` `sizes` attribute, a ``: - May be any non-negative length. - Must not be a percentage. - May use CSS math functions. - Other CSS functions are not valid. Older HTML specifications specifically allowed only `calc()` among CSS functions; the current MDN result describes the rule as allowing math functions generally.
